en.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.securi: Abnormal Security has emerged as the leader in AI-powered email security, protecting organizations from sophisticated phishing, business email compromise (BEC), and account takeover attacks that bypass traditional email gateways.
en.review.abnormal-security.using.behaviora: Using behavioral AI, Abnormal builds a baseline of normal communication patterns for every user and detects anomalies that indicate attacks—even when emails contain no malicious links or attachments.
en.review.abnormal-security.the.api-based.a: The API-based architecture integrates seamlessly with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace without requiring MX record changes or inline deployment.
en.review.abnormal-security.learns.communic: Learns communication patterns to detect anomalous emails indicating attacks.
en.review.abnormal-security.industry-leadin: Industry-leading detection of business email compromise and impersonation.
en.review.abnormal-security.detects.comprom: Detects compromised accounts based on behavioral indicators.
en.review.abnormal-security.stops.vendor.em: Stops vendor email compromise and supply chain attacks.
en.review.abnormal-security.easy.deployment: Easy deployment via API—no MX record changes required.
en.review.abnormal-security.automatically.r: Automatically removes malicious emails from all inboxes.
en.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.securi: Abnormal Security uses enterprise-focused pricing based on number of mailboxes and deployment scale:
Custom pricing per mailbox, typically starts at 1,000+ users
Pricing scales with number of protected email accounts
en.review.abnormal-security.all.features.in: All features included - no module-based upsells
en.review.abnormal-security.professional.se: Professional services available for deployment assistance
en.review.abnormal-security.typically.annua: Typically annual commitments with volume discounts
en.review.abnormal-security.pricing.justifi: Pricing justifies with prevented breach costs

en.review.abnormal-security.financial.servi: Financial Services: Banks and financial institutions facing targeted BEC attacks
en.review.abnormal-security.healthcare.medi: Healthcare: Medical organizations protecting patient data from phishing
en.review.abnormal-security.professional.se: Professional Services: Law firms, consulting firms with high-value wire transfers
en.review.abnormal-security.manufacturing.c: Manufacturing: Companies vulnerable to vendor email compromise in supply chain
en.review.abnormal-security.m365google.work: M365/Google Workspace: Organizations using Microsoft or Google cloud email
en.review.abnormal-security.small.businesse: Small businesses under 100 users (pricing not economical)
en.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.uses.a: Abnormal uses API-based deployment connecting directly to Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace. No MX record changes or mail flow modifications required. Deployment typically takes less than 30 minutes with minimal IT involvement.
en.review.abnormal-security.instead.of.sign: Instead of signature-based detection, Abnormal learns normal communication patterns for each user—who they email, writing style, timing, etc. It then detects anomalies indicating attacks, even when emails contain no malicious links or attachments.
en.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.typica: Abnormal typically works alongside existing SEGs (like Proofpoint or Mimecast) to catch sophisticated attacks they miss. Some organizations eventually replace their SEG, but most deploy Abnormal as an additional layer focused on advanced threats.
en.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.begins: Abnormal begins protecting immediately but improves detection accuracy during the first 30 days as it learns organizational communication patterns. Most value is realized within the first week of deployment.
en.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.has.on: Abnormal has one of the lowest false positive rates in the industry, typically under 0.1%. The behavioral AI approach means it understands context and catches real attacks while minimizing legitimate email blocking.
en.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.securi: Abnormal Security sets the standard for AI email security. Its behavioral approach catches sophisticated attacks that bypass traditional gateways. Essential for organizations facing advanced email threats.

pt.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.uses.a: Abnormal usa implantação baseada em API conectando diretamente a Microsoft 365 ou Google Workspace. Nenhuma alteração de registro MX ou modificações de fluxo de correio necessárias. A implantação normalmente leva menos de 30 minutos com envolvimento mínimo de TI.
pt.review.abnormal-security.instead.of.sign: Em vez de detecção baseada em assinatura, Abnormal aprende padrões normais de comunicação para cada usuário—quem eles enviam emails, estilo de escrita, timing, etc. Em seguida, detecta anomalias indicando ataques, mesmo quando os emails não contêm links maliciosos ou anexos.
pt.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.typica: Abnormal normalmente funciona junto com SEGs existentes (como Proofpoint ou Mimecast) para detectar ataques sofisticados que perdem. Algumas organizações eventualmente substituem seu SEG, mas a maioria implanta Abnormal como uma camada adicional focada em ameaças avançadas.
pt.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.begins: Abnormal começa a proteger imediatamente, mas melhora a precisão da detecção durante os primeiros 30 dias conforme aprende os padrões de comunicação organizacional. O máximo valor é realizado na primeira semana de implantação.
pt.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.has.on: Abnormal tem uma das menores taxas de falso positivo da indústria, normalmente abaixo de 0,1%. A abordagem de IA comportamental significa que entende contexto e detecta ataques reais enquanto minimiza o bloqueio de email legítimo.
pt.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.securi: Abnormal Security estabelece o padrão para segurança de email com IA. Sua abordagem comportamental detecta ataques sofisticados que contornam gateways tradicionais. Essencial para organizações enfrentando ameaças avançadas de email.

zh.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.securi: Abnormal Security已成为AI驱动的电子邮件安全领域的领导者,保护组织免受绕过传统电子邮件网关的复杂网络钓鱼、商业电子邮件泄露(BEC)和账户接管攻击。
zh.review.abnormal-security.using.behaviora: 使用行为AI,Abnormal为每个用户建立正常通信模式的基线,并检测表明攻击的异常情况——即使电子邮件不包含恶意链接或附件。
zh.review.abnormal-security.the.api-based.a: 基于API的架构与Microsoft 365和Google Workspace无缝集成,无需更改MX记录或进行内联部署。
zh.review.abnormal-security.learns.communic: 学习通信模式以检测表示攻击的异常电子邮件。
zh.review.abnormal-security.industry-leadin: 行业领先的商业电子邮件泄露和冒充检测。
zh.review.abnormal-security.detects.comprom: 基于行为指标检测被泄露的账户。
zh.review.abnormal-security.stops.vendor.em: 阻止供应商电子邮件泄露和供应链攻击。
zh.review.abnormal-security.easy.deployment: 通过API轻松部署——无需更改MX记录。
zh.review.abnormal-security.automatically.r: 自动从所有收件箱中删除恶意电子邮件。
zh.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.securi: Abnormal Security根据邮箱数量和部署规模采用企业级定价:
按邮箱自定义定价,通常从1000+用户开始

zh.review.abnormal-security.easier.deployme: 更简便的部署(API vs MX)
zh.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.uses.a: Abnormal使用基于API的部署,直接连接到Microsoft 365或Google Workspace。无需更改MX记录或邮件流修改。部署通常需不到30分钟,IT参与度最小。
zh.review.abnormal-security.instead.of.sign: Abnormal不是使用基于签名的检测,而是学习每个用户的正常通信模式——他们向谁发送电子邮件、写作风格、时间等。然后它检测表示攻击的异常,即使电子邮件不包含恶意链接或附件。
zh.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.typica: Abnormal通常与现有SEG(如Proofpoint或Mimecast)一起工作,以捕获它们遗漏的复杂攻击。一些组织最终会替换其SEG,但大多数将Abnormal部署为专注于高级威胁的额外防护层。
zh.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.begins: Abnormal立即开始保护,但在前30天内随着学习组织通信模式而改进检测准确性。大多数价值在部署的第一周内实现。
zh.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.has.on: Abnormal拥有业界最低的误报率之一,通常低于0.1%。行为AI方法意味着它理解上下文并捕获真实攻击,同时最大限度地减少合法电子邮件阻止。
zh.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.securi: Abnormal Security为AI电子邮件安全设立了标准。其行为方法可捕获绕过传统网关的复杂攻击。对于面临高级电子邮件威胁的组织至关重要。

ja.review.abnormal-security.explore.abnorma: Abnormal Securityのインターフェースを探索:
ja.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.uses.a: AbnormalはAPIベースの展開を使用して、Microsoft 365またはGoogle Workspaceに直接接続します。MXレコード変更やメールフロー変更は不要です。展開は通常30分以下で、ITの関与は最小限です。
ja.review.abnormal-security.instead.of.sign: シグネチャベースの検出の代わりに、Abnormalは各ユーザーの正常な通信パターン(誰にメールを送信するか、書き方、タイミングなど)を学習します。その後、メールに悪意のあるリンクまたは添付ファイルがない場合でも、攻撃を示す異常を検出します。
ja.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.typica: Abnormalは通常、既存のSEG(ProofpointやMimecastなど)と連携して、それらが見落とす高度な攻撃をキャッチします。一部の組織は最終的にSEGを置き換えますが、ほとんどは高度な脅威に焦点を当てた追加層としてAbnormalを展開します。
ja.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.begins: Abnormalは直ちに保護を開始しますが、組織の通信パターンを学習する最初の30日間で検出精度が向上します。ほとんどの価値は展開後の最初の週で実現されます。
ja.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.has.on: Abnormalは業界で最も低い偽陽性率の1つを持っており、通常0.1%未満です。行動AI方法は、コンテキストを理解し、正当なメール遮断を最小化しながら実際の攻撃をキャッチすることを意味します。
ja.review.abnormal-security.abnormal.securi: Abnormal Securityは、AIメールセキュリティの標準を設定しています。その行動アプローチは、従来のゲートウェイをバイパスする高度な攻撃をキャッチします。高度なメール脅威に直面している組織にとって不可欠です。
